# NaVILA: Legged Robot Vision-Language-Action Model for Navigation (RSS'25) [ ](https://navila-bot.github.io/) [ ](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.04453) [ ](https://huggingface.co/collections/a8cheng/navila-legged-robot-vision-language-action-model-for-naviga-67cfc82b83017babdcefd4ad) [ ](https://github.com/yang-zj1026/legged-loco) ## 💡 Introduction NaVILA is a two-level framework that combines VLAs with locomotion skills for navigation. It generates high-level language-based commands, while a real-time locomotion policy ensures obstacle avoidance. ## TODO - [x] Release mode/weight/evaluation. - [x] Release training code. (around June 30th) - [x] Release Isaac Sim evaluation, please see [here](https://github.com/yang-zj1026/NaVILA-Bench). ## 🚀 Training ### Installation To build environment for training NaVILA, please run the following: Optional: If you plan to use TensorBoard for logging, install `tensorboardX` via pip. ### Dataset For general VQA datasets like `video_chatgpt`, `sharegpt_video`, `sharegpt4v_sft`, please follow the data preparation instructions in [NVILA](https://github.com/NVlabs/VILA). We provide annotations for `envdrop`, `scanqa`, `r2r`, `rxr`, and `human` on [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/a8cheng/NaVILA-Dataset). Please download the repo and extract the `tar.gz` files in their respective subfolders. * **YouTube Human Touring:** Due to copyright restrictions, raw videos/images are not released. We provide **[video IDs](https://huggingface.co/datasets/a8cheng/NaVILA-Dataset/blob/main/Human/video_ids.txt)** and **annotations**. You can download the videos using `yt-dlp` and extract frames using: `scripts/extract_rawframes.py` * **EnvDrop:** Due to the large number of videos, we provide **annotations only**. >[!abstract] 一句话总结：提出 NaVILA 两级框架：上层以 VLA（基于 NVILA 的视觉-语言模型，输入单目视频与语言指令）输出中继语言动作（如「向前 1 米」「左转 30 度」），下层由实时 locomotion policy 将语言动作转成关节级控制并负责避障，实现语义决策与运动技能解耦。


# 一、动机

> 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型多针对桌面操作或轮式平台，缺少与实时低层运动控制结合、可零样本迁移到腿式机器人的导航方案；同时高层语义决策与低层避障往往被割裂，导致在真实非结构化环境中容易碰撞或漂移。


# 二、方法

> 提出 NaVILA 两级框架：上层以 VLA（基于 NVILA 的视觉-语言模型，输入单目视频与语言指令）输出中继语言动作（如「向前 1 米」「左转 30 度」），下层由实时 locomotion policy 将语言动作转成关节级控制并负责避障，实现语义决策与运动技能解耦。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 在 Isaac Sim 与真实腿式机器人（Unitree Go2）上验证：论文报告在真实未见环境中导航成功率达 88%，显著优于已有 VLA 基线；同时支持跨形态泛化（用轮式机器人数据训练的策略可零样本迁移到腿式平台），并开源了训练代码、Isaac Sim 评测（NaVILA-Bench）与 YouTube Human Touring 等数据集标注。


# 四、对我的启发

> 局限：上层 VLA 依赖大规模预训练 VLM，语言动作的粒度与推理延迟影响实时性；长程真实导航中的累积定位误差与分布外场景仍是主要失败来源。启发：用「语言作为中间动作空间」是连接高层语义与低层控制、实现跨具身迁移的可行范式，可为其他具身导航任务提供解耦式设计参考。
